secondary_endpoints.direction: No directional alternative was fixed in Stage 59D; therefore all secondary permutation tests are two-sided.
secondary_endpoints.multiplicity_adjustment: Holm across the seven secondary endpoints

activity_level: AUROC computed from the 32 activity-level median endpoint values
reported_discrimination_metrics.score_orientation: Raw endpoint orientation is preserved; scores are never multiplied by minus one after labels are observed.

sampling.positive_clusters: Sample 20 positive activities with replacement from the 20 positive activities.
sampling.negative_clusters: Sample 12 negative activities with replacement from the 12 negative activities.
sampling.sequence_metrics: Retain all five repetitions for every sampled activity-cluster occurrence.
sampling.activity_metric: Use the median endpoint value of each sampled activity-cluster occurrence.
sampling.duplicate_cluster_occurrences: Duplicated bootstrap clusters are treated as separate resampled cluster occurrences.

bootstrap_contract.invalid_resample_policy: Not expected under stratified sampling; any invalid resample causes analysis failure.

primary_permutation_test.label_permutation: Randomly assign exactly 20 of the 32 activity clusters to the positive class and the remaining 12 to the negative class.

secondary_permutation_tests.seed_rule: 59040 plus the zero-based secondary endpoint index
secondary_permutation_tests.label_permutation: Randomly assign exactly 20 positive and 12 negative activity labels.
secondary_permutation_tests.adjustment: Holm family-wise correction over seven tests

effect_size.name: Cliff's delta
effect_size.formula: (number of positive-negative pairs with positive value greater than negative value minus number with lower value) divided by 20 times 12

execution_order: Verify frozen dataset, feature, endpoint, protocol, and contract hashes.
Read the frozen endpoint table and frozen opaque lineage table.
Read the Stage 59A author-defined label manifest for the first time.
Join labels by filename through the frozen lineage table.
Verify 160 one-to-one joins, 32 activities, five repetitions per activity, 100 positive and 60 negative sequences.
Compute all fixed descriptive and discrimination metrics.
Run fixed bootstrap and permutation analyses.
Write all results without endpoint selection, threshold fitting, or sample exclusion.
failure_conditions: Any deviation from 20 positive and 12 negative activities
